chapter: Encounters Always Happen on a Holiday
act_title: Encounters Always Happen on a Holiday

quests.title: Encounters Always Happen on a Holiday

dialogue.t: Look, there are people over there!

dialogue.sit: Huh, they look familiar. I think that's...

dialogue.t: Ororon and Ifa!
Oh, Gramps(other Granny) and Paimon! I knew those were voices I recognized!
Bros! Bros!
Hah! You're here at the resort, too! Man, it's been a while!
Yep! Chasca told us you've been working here. Guess we were bound to run into each other at some point!
Yeah, for sure. Yo, this place has a nice vibe to it, don't you think? I hear everyone's been having a blast.
Hehe, definitely! With any luck, it'll only get better, and we'll get even more visitors!
What about you two? How's your work going?
Not bad! The saurian staff and the aphids are all in good health and full of energy, so we had some free time on our hands. Thought we'd take a look around.
...Aphid STAFF.
Huh?
The aphids are part of the staff, too. You missed that part.
You can say that again, bro!
Right... My bad. I'm grateful to our entire staff, of course. And, to Mr. Ororon, for looking out for them so... proactively.
We got here early to fight for an important cause. That's its own reward.
You see, this is my bro's first time getting a formal invitation like that, and as you can probably tell, he's very, um... committed.
See? Gramps(Other Granny) knows what he's(she's) talking about.
Every day, we get a new chance to fight for what's important. Cacucu taught me that.
Haha!
But, aren't you just... fishing? Since when did that count as "fighting for what's important"?
Do you even hear yourself?
Since it was suggested by a friend, of course. He's a famous adventurer from Mondstadt with incredible luck. If he says it'll work, who are we to argue?
Yeah, that bro spun a stick around and it ended up pointing at this pond. As Ororon put it — better to follow luck where it leads than try to make your own. So, we came to fish here.
Okay, even if that made sense... This pond is surrounded by capybaras! Can you even fish here?
Of course! Capybaras are gentle creatures, so we're good. Besides, when life gives you water, you fish. That's what Granny taught me.
Ah, another one of Granny's pearls of wisdom. Along with, "when life gives you food, you eat" or "when life gives you lemons, make lemonade."
Haha, exactly. Except, we're the ones handing you lemons this time, Gramps(other Granny) and Paimon. Since you're here, why don't you fish with us?
And, to up the ante a bit... Whoever catches the biggest fish gets a pint of Ororon's Aphimead.
Now that's an offer Paimon can get behind!
Hehehe, did you forget who you're dealing with here? We never back away from a challenge, and {NICKNAME} is a tough opponent!
Got your game face on, I see! Alright, I'm down!
As the elder, you should go first, Gramps(other Granny).
As the elder, you should go first, Gramps(other Granny).
Wow, the competition's really heating up! Here comes a pro move from {NICKNAME}... and there's a bite! {NICKNAME} reels it in, and up comes a...
Hold on... is that... an Asha?
Wow... Not exactly the kind of catch I was expecting! Not super sure how we're gonna judge that...
Nice one, Gramps(other Granny)! We'll have to see if anyone manages to reel in something even more special. Otherwise, that might be enough for the win.

dialogue.sit: Thanks, everyone! I'm up against some fierce competition, but I think I've got a shot. Let's hope my grandson is right!

dialogue.t: Quite the impressive showing from {NICKNAME}! That'll be a tough act for the remaining two competitors to follow!
Ifa, you're up!
You've got this, bro! Teamwork makes the dream work!
Sorry, Cacucu. There's no room for teamwork here.
Whoa, look alive, bros... I've got something!

dialogue.sit: Ifa reels in the rod with all his strength. Looks like he's caught something big...
Huh... Looks like Ifa reeled in a koholasaur... towing a capybara? Not sure what's going on there...

quests.description: While strolling around the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, you and Paimon spot some familiar figures…
